en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a town marketplace with two‑ and three‑story buildings lining a wide, empty street. The left foreground shows a corner building with tall windows; on the right are older houses with stairways leading up from the street. In the distance, a few people and horse‑drawn vehicles are visible. The sky area is mostly blank, with red printed German text at the top and publisher information at the bottom.
